lede: The biggest thing on the government calendar this week is the San Miguel County BOCC's special meeting Wednesday, where they'll consider changing Area Median Income limits on deed-restricted properties in Pinion Park — a technical-sounding move that directly affects who qualifies for local housing. Also worth watching: Ridgway's Town Council meets Wednesday to ratify letters supporting a federal Major Disaster Declaration for the Gold Mountain Fire, which has torched nearly 40,000 acres and repeatedly cut off Highway 550, and the County Planning Commission takes up three Land Use Code amendments covering forestry, oil and gas, and geothermal energy.

notable.stake: AMI change on deed-restricted Pinion Park units decides who qualifies for local housing.
Council ratifies disaster declaration support for Gold Mountain Fire recovery — public record matters.
